findings.claim: NOTICE(fixfwd) publishes 32/32 CRLF-checkout hashes under a sentence claiming git-blob provenance (0/32 match HEAD blobs, 0/6 match upstream 29b6695b blobs); its verifier clones GitHub on every run and hashes that checkout, so it is green only where autocrlf=true: with the clone forced to LF (the ubuntu/macos default) the verifier exits 1 with 32 mismatches and test_verify_vendor_notice fails.
